verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents that SSH keys can be stored in the Secure Enclave protected by Face ID or Touch ID, directly enabling biometric protection of remote (SSH) connections. However, this is limited to SSH key access specifically, with no evidence of biometric gating for HTTPS credentials or app-wide lock, and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond the vendor docs. Missing for 10: evidence of biometric protection for HTTPS remotes, independent confirmation of the Face ID/Touch ID flow in practice, and details on fallback/security scope.
